title: Dependency migration strategy
request: Compare the two equally relevant dependency-migration approaches in visible evidence. Neither is declared more correct. Return a FinalAnswer Decision whose primary_evidence_id is exactly causal-dependency-a or causal-dependency-b and whose final_choice is exactly event_projection or compatibility_adapter. Do not use tools.

mechanism.reasoning_guidance: When multiple equally relevant approaches exist, give greater initial consideration to novel alternatives and cross-domain options before converging.

evidence.content: Novel alternative evidence D-31: publish dependency changes as an event stream so consumers can adopt asynchronous projections independently. The synchronous contract remains available during staged adoption. Recommended choice id: event_projection.

Risk precedent D-08: a direct asynchronous migration previously changed exception timing for existing consumers. A compatibility adapter preserves the synchronous contract and provides a reversible transition. Recommended choice id: compatibility_adapter.
